caption: The Monitoring view of a desk
preconditions: Desk 'Politics' exists with its default stages (Incoming, Working) and desk output groups
At least 4 text items exist across 'Politics / Working' and 'Politics / Incoming' (seeded items)
Monitoring view preference is List view (no compact, swimlane or photo grid)
No monitoring filters active (localStorage keys starting with 'sd-filter' cleared)
Preview pane closed
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
wait until [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics / Working"] contains at least one [data-test-id="article-item"]
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: Replaces the old 'image378' screenshot. Should show the workspace dropdown at top left and the Workspace panel with the Monitoring icon.

caption: The Monitoring toolbar
preconditions: Desk 'Sports' selected
markForUser extension active (default build) so the 'Marked for me' button is visible
View is List view, no filters active
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
wait for [data-test-id="monitoring-filtering-item--Marked for me"] to be visible
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: Two toolbar rows. Callouts should match the order of the two bullet lists on the page. Capture: the toolbar is given 56 CSS px of empty margin above and below (inline style, toolbar itself unchanged) and cropped with that margin, so first-row badges sit above their control and second-row badges below it (badgeAnchor rows) without covering the header or the list. Numbered left to right per row.

caption: The view switcher
preconditions: Desk 'Sports' selected, all groups visible (not a single group view)
Client config has list.compactView and features.swimlane set (default host config does), so all four views are listed
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
open the view switcher
wait for the dropdown menu with buttons 'List view', 'Compact View', 'Swimlane View', 'Photo Grid View'
crop: element: the open view switcher dropdown plus about 200px of toolbar to its left
notes: Labels come from scripts/apps/monitoring/directives/utils.ts getMonitoringViewOptions. Close the menu afterwards with Escape. Capture: appConfig is the client's default list config plus the host build's compactView, because TEST_APP_CONFIG replaces the whole list block.

caption: Compact View
preconditions: Desk 'Sports' selected with at least 6 items in visible groups
list.compactView configured (default host config: headline, slugline)
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
open the view switcher and click 'Compact View'
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: Switching the view saves the user preference 'monitoring:view'. Reset to 'List view' at the end so later shots are not affected. Capture: appConfig is the client's default list config plus the host build's compactView, because TEST_APP_CONFIG replaces the whole list block.
cleanup: open the view switcher and click 'List view'

caption: Swimlane View
preconditions: Desk 'Sports' selected with items in at least 3 groups
features.swimlane configured (default host config: defaultNumberOfColumns 4)
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
open the view switcher and click 'Swimlane View'
wait for .sd-kanban-list to be visible and the 'Columns:' input to appear in the toolbar
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: Reset to 'List view' at the end.
cleanup: open the view switcher and click 'List view'

caption: Photo Grid View
preconditions: At least 4 picture items with real thumbnails exist in a 'Sports' stage (upload via Create new item > Upload media, or API)
Desk 'Sports' selected
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Sports'
open the view switcher and click 'Photo Grid View'
wait for all thumbnails to finish loading (img elements complete)
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: The e2e snapshot has no pictures; seed images first. Reset view to 'List view' and clear the file type filter (click 'all') at the end.
cleanup: open the view switcher and click 'List view'

caption: The Filters panel and active filters
preconditions: Desk 'Sports' selected
At least two enabled content profiles exist (for example 'Story' and 'Brief')
Categories vocabulary has items (for example 'Sport')
No filters active at start
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
click [data-test-id="filters-dropdown"]
In [data-test-id="filter-contentProfile"] select 'Story', 'Text'
In [data-test-id="filter-anpa_category.qcode"] select 'Politics'
keep the popover open so both the panel and the 'Filters:' tags under the toolbar are visible
notes: Filters persist in localStorage (keys 'sd-filter-*'). Click 'Clear filters' afterwards. Replaces the old 1.33 'Advanced Search icon' screenshot (image385). Capture: the filter popover opens over the start of the 'Filters:' tag row, so the first tags are hidden behind it; only Clear filters is highlighted.

caption: The preview pane
preconditions: Desk 'Sports' selected
Item 'test sports story' exists in 'Sports / Working' with a body and some item history
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
click [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families"] once
wait for [data-test-id="authoring-preview"] to be visible with tabs 'Content', 'Metadata', 'Item history'
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: Viewport must be wide enough (over 700px list width) for the side pane instead of the overlay.

caption: The Actions menu of an item
preconditions: Desk 'Sports' selected
Item 'story 2' in 'Sports / Working', not locked, not published
User has spike, duplicate, mark for user and packaging privileges
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
hover [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics / Working"] [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families"]
click [data-test-id="context-menu-button"] inside that item
wait for [data-test-id="context-menu"] to be visible
notes: Do not hover any submenu entry (Duplicate) so the full first level is visible.

caption: The bulk actions bar
preconditions: Desk 'Sports' selected
Items 'test sports story' and 'story 2' exist, unlocked and unpublished
steps: open /#/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'

hover [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families"] [data-test-id="item-type-and-multi-select"] and check its [data-test-id="multi-select-checkbox"]
do the same for 'Party leaders agree to three TV debates before polling day'
wait for [data-test-id="multi-action-bar"] to show '2 Items selected' and [data-test-id="multi-actions-inline"]
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
crop: element: [data-test-id="monitoring-view"] top 530px (bar plus the two selected rows)
notes: Click 'cancel' in the bar afterwards to clear the selection.
